# Simulated Data

```{r}
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
```

```{r}
sim_cases <- sim_pop %>%

```


## Cleaning
### all cases
```{r}
infected <- sim_cases %>% 
  mutate(symptom_onset = tau - round(runif(1, 3, 10), 0)) %>%

```
write to txt file
```{r}
write.table(infected, file = "infected.txt", sep = " ", row.names = FALSE,
```


# Real Data
import data:
```{r}
## cases
suspected <- here::here("data", "TIRS_SINAVE_combined22_23_blockID.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
```

## Cleaning
```{r}
# Cases only (no negative diagnoses)
cases <- suspected %>% 
  filter(Diagnosis != "Negativo") %>% 
  filter(Comentario != "Negativo") %>% 
  # only 2023, only dengue
  filter((str_detect(Diagnosis, "DENV") | str_detect(Diagnosis, "DENGUE"))
         & Year == 2023) %>% 
  # some duplicates (7), take only the first row of each ID
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(block_id = ifelse(is.na(MZTIRS), CVE_MZA, MZTIRS),
         person_id = row_number())

# # some duplicates?
# cases %>% count(ID) %>% filter(n > 1)
```

Format to match c.positives.alpha.txt
```{r}
positives <- cases %>% 
  # IDperson, IDblock, IDcluster, date_symptoms, TIRS_arm, coordinates
  dplyr::select(person_id, block_id, CLUSTER, Week_onset, Arm_1TIRS) %>% 
  rename(cluster_id = CLUSTER,
         trial_arm = Arm_1TIRS,
         week_sympt_onset = Week_onset)
```

write to txt file
```{r}
write.table(positives, file = "real_dat_pos.txt", sep = " ", row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE)
```


# MCMC Results
Read in results
```{r}
chain1 <- here::here("tirs_model", "output", "mcmc.50000.txt") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
chain2 <- here::here("tirs_model", "output", "mcmc.50000.txt") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
chain3 <- here::here("tirs_model", "output", "mcmc.50000.txt") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
```


```{r}
here()
mcmc_chains <- read.table(
  here("model_output", "mcmc_chains", "mcmc.alpha-s1.txt"), 
  sep=" ", 
  header = TRUE)
mcmc_chains <- mcmc_chains %>% 
  mutate(iter = row_number())
mcmc_long <- mcmc_chains %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(alpha, gamma, Gta, Gtb, nSim, logL, nAccept),
               names_to = "fitted_var",
               values_to = "value") 

plot_trace_density <- function(variable, colour = "#2C3E50") {
  trace <- ggplot(filter(mcmc_long, fitted_var == variable),
                  aes(x = iter, y = value)) +
    geom_line(colour = colour, alpha = 0.6) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = variable,
         x = NULL,
         y = NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  dens <- ggplot(filter(mcmc_long, fitted_var == variable),
                 aes(x = value)) +
    geom_density(fill = colour, alpha = 0.25, colour = "NA") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(y = NULL,
         x = NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  grid.arrange(trace, dens, nrow = 2, heights = c(2, 1))
}

plot_trace_density("alpha")
```
